description: Grid Supply Point Insights is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction Dataset providing visibility of UK Power Network’s demand forecasts for its GSPs over the next eight years, across the four different demand scenarios. No tertiary connections or other transmission-connected parties have been considered in this forecast, which is based only on demand from our Distribution network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
